citations.quote: Also, even under an “independent float” regime monetary authorities will occasionally intervene in foreign exchange markets in order to influence the value of their domestic currency.
In either case, the country gives up the ability to conduct its own monetary policy.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: CFA L1 R14 currency-exchange framework: spot/forward quote mechanics with bid-offer spread, three parity conditions (CIRP, absolute PPP, relative PPP), capital-flow effects on FX, and the Mundell-Fleming taxonomy with the impossible trinity.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Currency Exchange Rates and Parity Framework (Notes Ch.9)
